    Trace and reject #

    For a subcategory T and an object X of an abelian category with a length function, the trace t_T(X) is the largest subobject of X lying in T, and for a subcategory F the reject r_F(X) is the smallest subobject K of X with X/K in F (Definition 2.7 and Proposition 2.10 of the manuscript). The manuscript defines the trace as the sum of the images of all morphisms from objects of T and the reject as the intersection of the kernels of all morphisms to objects of F; trace_le_iff and le_reject_iff show that these descriptions agree with ours when T is quotient-closed and F is subobject-closed. The finiteness of Lemma 2.9 enters through the length function, which provides maximal and minimal subobjects.
